name: fix_tasktracker_search_sql_injection
description: L3 repo-scale: parameterize the raw-SQL task search endpoint (SQL injection via string interpolation); incomplete-fix broken variant strips ; and -- only
prompts: In this fastapi-tasktracker repo, the task search endpoint at app/routers/search.py builds its SQL by f-string interpolation of the user-supplied q parameter into a LIKE clause - a classic SQL injection (q=\"' OR '1'='1\" dumps every row, and a legitimate apostrophe like q=\"Bob's\" breaks the query outright). Fix it properly: the query text must contain no user input - pass the search term as a bound parameter (e.g. sqlalchemy text() with a :pattern placeholder and .bindparams(), keeping the %...% wildcards in the bound value). Do not attempt to sanitize or escape the input string instead of parameterizing. The endpoint's contract is unchanged: GET /search/tasks?q=<term> returns tasks whose title contains the term, ordered by id, with the same response shape; an empty q returns all tasks.

setup_files.app/routers/search.py:
from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app import schemas
from app.db.session import get_db

router = APIRouter(prefix="/search", tags=["search"])


@router.get("/tasks", response_model=list[schemas.TaskOut])
def search_tasks(q: str = "", db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    sql = text(
        f"SELECT id, title, description, status, priority, project_id, assignee_id "
        f"FROM tasks WHERE title LIKE '%{q}%' ORDER BY id"
    )
    rows = db.execute(sql).mappings().all()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]

test_setup_files.tests/test_search_hidden.py:
def _seed(client):
    user = client.post("/users", json={"username": "s", "email": "s@example.com"}).json()
    project = client.post("/projects", json={"name": "Search", "owner_id": user["id"]}).json()
    for title in ["Deploy alpha", "Write docs", "Bob's report"]:
        client.post("/tasks", json={"title": title, "project_id": project["id"]})


def test_search_matches_substring(client):
    _seed(client)
    resp = client.get("/search/tasks", params={"q": "alpha"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert [t["title"] for t in resp.json()] == ["Deploy alpha"]


def test_injection_is_treated_as_a_literal(client):
    _seed(client)
    resp = client.get("/search/tasks", params={"q": "' OR '1'='1"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == [], "injection payload must match nothing, not dump every row"


def test_quote_in_search_term_is_safe(client):
    _seed(client)
    resp = client.get("/search/tasks", params={"q": "Bob's"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert [t["title"] for t in resp.json()] == ["Bob's report"]


def test_empty_query_returns_everything(client):
    _seed(client)
    resp = client.get("/search/tasks", params={"q": ""})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert len(resp.json()) == 3

from __future__ import annotations

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app import schemas
from app.db.session import get_db

router = APIRouter(prefix="/search", tags=["search"])


@router.get("/tasks", response_model=list[schemas.TaskOut])
def search_tasks(q: str = "", db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    cleaned = q.replace(";", "").replace("--", "")
    sql = text(
        f"SELECT id, title, description, status, priority, project_id, assignee_id "
        f"FROM tasks WHERE title LIKE '%{cleaned}%' ORDER BY id"
    )
    rows = db.execute(sql).mappings().all()
    return [dict(r) for r in rows]
